# Jessel Zapanta — Full Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Jessel Zapanta, a full stack web developer based in Tangub City, Philippines, specializing in Laravel, React, and Tailwind CSS.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://jeszapanta.vercel.app/): Introduction, availability, and highlights.
- [About](https://jeszapanta.vercel.app/#About): Background, approach, and experience.
- [Skills](https://jeszapanta.vercel.app/#Skills): React, Laravel, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, Inertia.js, and Vite.
- [Projects](https://jeszapanta.vercel.app/#Projects): Selected full-stack work with live demos and source links.
- [Contact](https://jeszapanta.vercel.app/#Contact): Email, phone, location, CV, and contact form.

## Selected projects

- [TCGC SmartLog](https://tcgc-smartlog.vercel.app/): OJT monitoring platform for Tangub City Global College — DTR, journals, requirements, evaluations, and reports.
- [TCGC DisciScan](https://tcgc-disciscan.vercel.app/): Disciplinary records and monitoring system with violations, sanctions, case workflows, and role-based dashboards.
- [Suki Cart](https://suki-cart.vercel.app/): E-commerce platform with catalog, cart, and checkout, built as a PWA.
- [HRDRMS](https://github.com/JesselZapanta/hrrms): Desktop HR records management for LGU Ozamiz — encrypted employee files, role-based access, and folder-style categories.
- [Torch Publication](http://torch.gadtc.edu.ph/): Publication platform for article submission, moderation, and e-newsletter distribution.
- [Project Monitoring System](https://github.com/JesselZapanta/tcepms): Engineering project tracking for road, waterworks, and building construction.
- [Inventory Management System](https://github.com/JesselZapanta/ims): Inventory control for categories, suppliers, users, and stock.
